text:
alex: Heads up — opened PR 4673 to tighten IAM for the canary cluster service account. Needs one more approval before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4673
kevin: on it, will take a look in ~30m
mia: quick q — is this changing assume-role or attaching a new inline policy to the SA?
alex: attaching a narrowly-scoped inline policy that allows sts:AssumeRole to the canary-runner role only. diff excerpt below.
alex: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "canary_assume" {
  name = "canary-assume-role-policy"
  role = aws_iam_role.canary_sa.id
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow",
      Action = ["sts:AssumeRole"],
      Resource = aws_iam_role.canary_runner_role.arn,
      Condition = {
        ArnEquals = {
          "aws:SourceArn" = "arn:aws:ec2:us-west-2:instance/*"
        }
      }
    }]
  })
}
```
ranjit: security ping — please run tfsec and policy-check in the PR. Any failing checks will block merge.

alex: added a condition block for aws:SourceIp with the canary EIP range and pushed. re-running plan.

alex: thanks everyone.
